name: @gofastr/genui-bundle
description: In-frame renderer bundle for the GoFastr genui plugin. Builds a single IIFE (React + react-dom bundled, statically imported — no dynamic import, no lazy loading, the registry is compiled in and that is the containment story) that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage. The composition tree arrives host-validated and is validated AGAIN here against the compiled-in registry before rendering: unknown components, undeclared props, unlisted actions and runaway depth/count are refused loudly in the UI, not dropped. connect-src 'none' still holds — the frame never talks to a model, holds a key, or opens a socket.
